body.description: The Project proposes a change of use from an existing Limited Restaurant use (dba “Bizza”) to Restaurant use, which will sell on-sale alcoholic beverages on the ground floor, pursuant to Planning Code Section 303, 719, and 781.9. The change of use will permit on-sale beer and wine for operation as a bona fide eating establishment, pending approval of ABC license. No interior or exterior alterations are proposed.

Proposed project includes interior alterations on the first floor with associated MEP upgrades. Work on the second floor includes demolition of the existing office and full bathroom, construction of a new stair to the first floor, and addition of a new study, powder room, pantry, and deck. No work is proposed on the third floor. All existing windows to be replaced like‑in‑kind.

Alter approved site permit 2024/1024/3707 to include the following additional exterior scope items: expand roof penthouse room 30" to the south; convert existing flat roof to occupied deck at 3rd flr; relocate exterior yard access stair; exterior door & window changes; alter lower entry steps & include 104 sf of property line fencing along Buena Vista West & Frederick St
The project proposes to remove the existing enclosed porch in the rear yard and construction of a new exterior rear deck and stair.

Applicant seeks conditional use approval to establish a new off-sale liquor establishment in the Haight Street Alcohol Restricted Use Subdistrict (RUSD) as authorized pursuant to Section 781.9(c)(2), which new liquor establishment will be situated at 1416 Haight Street.

The project proposes a horizontal expansion of the third floor for an existing three-story, 12-unit apartment building facing Waller Street. The existing one-bedroom, one-bath unit will become a four-bedroom, three-bath unit after the proposed horizontal expansion is completed. The front elevation will be slightly modified but the character of the 1963 building will remain. The side and rear elevations are fully obscured from view by the buildings on the adjacent properties.

Alteration and conversion of an existing two-story garage at the rear of the property into an ADU with a garage below per Planning Code Section 207.2. The project seeks two variances to build within the rear yard setback and to replace the existing non-original, 12' wide garage door with two 7' wide garage doors spaced 1'-10 3/4" apart.
The project includes construction of three accessor dwelling units (ADU). Two converted at 3rd floor in the rear and and one attached at the 5th floor.

Conditional Use Authorization pursuant to Planning Code Section 719 and Bos Ordinance 249-23 for a change of use from an existing Limited-Restaurant in the Haight NCD to a Full Service Restaurant which will sell on-sale alcoholic beverages on the ground floor. No proposed work.

Per Planning Code Section 207.1 (Local), the project proposes the construction of three ADUs. Two will be located at the third floor rear in the existing storage space and one will be located in the fifth floor horizontal expansion. The building underwent mandatory seismic retrofit per SFBC Chapter 4D under 201712277461 and 202010025720. Both third floor ADU units will be one-bedroom, one-bath units and the fifth floor ADU unit will be a three-bedroom, two-bath unit. The third floor ADU units in the rear are not visible from the street and the fifth floor ADU unit is more than 70 ft. away from the front property line and more than 50 ft. higher than the sidewalk; it is not expected to be completely obscured from street visibility. The side and rear elevations are fully obscured from view by the existing buildings on the adjacent properties constructed to their side property lines while the subject building has 4 ft. and 8 ft. wide side yards on both sides. The existing four-story building has 12 dwelling units.
Alter approved site permit 2022/0713/8359 to include an additional 47 square feet of rear horizontal addition at 2nd floor. New kitchen renovation. Add wet bar at first floor media room.
